blocks.html: Flagpoles that are supported entirely from the building may be constructed to project not more than 18 feet (5486 mm) beyond the street line, but not closer than 2 feet (610 mm) to the curb line, provided that no part of the flagpole is less than 15 feet (4572 mm) above the ground or sidewalk level.
